title: UniSD: Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.06597v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self-distillation (SD) offers a promising path for adapting large language models (LLMs) without relying on stronger external teachers. However, SD in autoregressive LLMs remains challenging because self-generated trajectories are free-form, correctness is task-dependent, and plausible rationales can still provide unstable or unreliable supervision. Existing methods mainly examine isolated design choices, leaving their effectiveness, roles, and interactions unclear. In this paper, we propose UniSD, a unified framework to systematically study self-distillation. UniSD integrates complementary mechanisms that address supervision reliability, representation alignment, and training stability, including multi-teacher agreement, EMA teacher stabilization, token-level contrastive learning, feature matching, and divergence clipping. translated_title: UniSD：面向大语言模型的统一自蒸馏框架
translated_abstract: 自蒸馏（SD）为在不依赖更强外部教师模型的情况下适配大语言模型（LLM）提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，自回归LLM中的自蒸馏仍然充满挑战，因为自生成的轨迹是自由形式的，正确性依赖于具体任务，且看似合理的推理过程仍可能提供不稳定或不可靠的监督信号。现有方法主要考察孤立的设计选择，导致其有效性、作用及相互关系尚不明确。本文提出了UniSD，一个用于系统研究自蒸馏的统一框架。UniSD整合了解决监督可靠性、表示对齐和训练稳定性问题的互补机制，包括多教师一致性、EMA教师稳定化、词元级对比学习、特征匹配和散度裁剪。在来自三个模型系列的六个基准测试和六个模型上，UniSD揭示了自蒸馏何时有效（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了统一自蒸馏框架UniSD，通过整合多教师一致性、EMA教师稳定化、词元级对比学习、特征匹配和散度裁剪等互补机制，系统性地解决了大语言模型自蒸馏中监督可靠性、表示对齐与训练稳定性的核心难题。
en_tdlr: UniSD is a unified self-distillation framework for LLMs that integrates complementary mechanisms—multi-teacher agreement, EMA teacher stabilization, token-level contrastive learning, feature matching, and divergence clipping—to systematically address supervision reliability, representation alignment, and training stability.
